description:
An authenticated attacker granted the guest role on a BIG-IP system can modify the SMTP Server Host Name as well as the SMTP Server Port Number settings and run the Test Connection feature.

This issue occurs when the following condition is met:

The affected BIG-IP system is configured to send mail through an SMTP server and has an existing SMTP configuration on the System > Configuration > Device > SMTP page.

Note: The guest role does not have the permissions to create a new SMTP configuration on the BIG-IP system.
title: K000156643: BIG-IP SMTP configuration security exposure
